text:
maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — new vendor wants their open quantized model listed in cloud marketplaces and a downloadable SKU. Need alignment on redistribution + geoblocking + announcement cadence.

jake (Legal): Re: redistribution — do we have a preferred addendum for quantized weights? I want to avoid ‘redistribution’ language that inadvertently permits 3rd-party hosting.

maria (Partnerships): @jake yes please. They sent a permissive MIT-style header but also added a commercial redistribution paragraph. Unsure if we can accept binary downloads in all regions.

jake (Legal): Paste of suggested clause below — please review.

```
Redistribution Addendum (Redwood-approved):
Vendor grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to host, distribute (download and stream) and sublicense to end customers subject to region-specific export controls and agreed embargo windows. Redistribution excludes resale as a standalone model bundle to third-party marketplaces without prior written consent.
```

sophia (Product): Important: hosting vs download affects Console experience and billing. If we allow downloads, Dedicated/Private customers will expect the same support SLA. Also need a marketplace SKU mapping.

liam (Eng): Technical flag — quantized weights have multiple format variants (.pt, .safetensors, int8/q4). We need a compatibility matrix for runtime. If we accept 'download', we must publish supported format list and a note about runtime-backed inference vs local repacking.

maria (Partnerships): Good point. @liam can you draft the compatibility matrix? I can include in partner onboarding docs.

liam (Eng): Will do. Quick question: do we want to enforce a single canonical quantization format for marketplace distribution to simplify kernels?

jake (Legal): From legal side, prefer we avoid mandating a single format — that looks like product constraints. But contract should require vendor to provide checksums and provenance metadata for each distributed artifact.

claudia-bot: Reminder: partnership-onboard checklist due in 48h for vendor 4/21. Items pending: legal clause, packaging spec, export review. :spiral_calendar: 

maria (Partnerships): Proposed action items: 1) @jake finalize redistribution clause with provenance + embargo language; 2) @liam publish format compatibility matrix; 3) @sophia map SKU + decide hosted vs downloadable SKUs per region; 4) partnership PM to draft announcement cadence (canary announce then GA).

sophia (Product): For announcements: 2-week soft launch in NA + EU, geoblocked download in APAC pending export sign-off. We should do coordinated blog + partner marketplace listing + partner webinar. Suggest a canary run to 5 SIs first.

jake (Legal): I'll update clause and add an export compliance paragraph referencing our export-policy doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/export-policy. Also push a short checkbox: vendor must confirm they hold rights to sublicense compiled/quantized artifacts.

maria (Partnerships): Thanks. If we can get draft clause and matrix by EOD tomorrow I can schedule a legal+product review on Friday.

liam (Eng): Draft matrix note: "supported runtimes: redwood-runtime-v2, runtime-guest-compat; formats: .safetensors(-q4), .pth(int8)" — will flesh out and include example load command.

maria (Partnerships): Example load command snippet from @liam will be great for partner docs. Also need a short blurb about fallbacks: if runtime mismatch, default to hosted variant (streaming) rather than download.

claudia-bot: Checklist update: legal clause: pending; format matrix: pending; export review: queued. Deadline: 48h.

maria (Partnerships): Awesome. Final note: try to avoid the phrase "open distribution" in public text — use "partner-hosted" or "downloadable under license". Helps set expectations. :memo: 

jake (Legal): Got it. I'll circulate redline in this thread when ready.

sophia (Product): I'll start SKU mapping doc and include pricing tiers (hosted vs download + enterprise transfer license). Share link when ready.

maria (Partnerships): Great — moving to review. Thanks team! :rocket:
